text:
deploy-bot: Release RC-9 to prod blocked by security gate — vuln scan FAIL
deploy-bot: scan-id: scan-rc9-2026-04-11

sylvia: pinging sec here. what's the vuln?

ashley: CVE-2026-1421 in libfastparse.so (third-party). severity: HIGH. It's used by analytics pipeline only, behind feature-flag.

devon: QA confirms feature-flag toggled off in canary, but prod image still includes the library.

ashley: exploitability: remote code exec via crafted input to parse() — depends on endpoint exposure. Not called in main inference path.

rachel-legal: any license/contract issue? or just vuln? we need severity for compliance docs.

ashley: only vuln. No license issue. We should decide pin vs carveout. Options:
- pin to previous image w/o lib
- carveout region (EU) where traffic is low
- hotpatch the image (might take >4h)

sylvia: change window is open for 2h. We need decision in 20m. Can we do a regional carveout + staggered rollout?

matt-sre: carving out EU is doable via routing rules in 30m, rollback safe. Rollback to previous image across EU or divert EU to standby cluster?

jen-eng: hotpatch pipeline queued, ETA ~3h including CI. Not within window.

devon: QA thumbs-up for pin to previous image (rc-8 image) — smoke tested.

ashley: security preference: pin image now and create expedited hotpatch post-rollout to remove lib. Pin reduces exposure ASAP.

sylvia: I vote pin for EU carveout? Wait — pin globally to rc-8 or pin only EU?

matt-sre: pin globally simpler and faster. Carveout partial rollout increases blast radius for rollout logic. Pin to rc-8 for all regions for safety, then re-roll rc-9 after hotpatch.

sylvia: downside: delays features in other regions. But safety first.

rachel-legal: confirm we log decision and update release notes: "rollback: rc-9 -> rc-8 due to third-party vuln" and notify customers affected by changelog.

sylvia: decision: pin release to rc-8 globally. Timeline:
- +5m: stop RC-9 rollout
- +10m: pin rc-8 and run deploybot rollback
- +15m: smoke tests
- +60m: create hotpatch branch and start expedited fix

deploy-bot: received. initiating rollback job deploy/rc9 -> deploy/rc8

deploy-bot: job 8812 started: rolling back canaries -> 2 regions

devon: I'll run smoke tests once canaries green.

matt-sre: setting monitoring to elevated for next 2 hours. alert if error-rate >0.5% :eyes:

ashley: filing tracking ticket SEC-2026-1421-hotpatch with priority P0.

rachel-legal: I'll draft a short release note and internal compliance entry.

jen-eng: note for post-mortem: add automation to strip optional libs from prod images when feature flag off.

sylvia: thanks team. circle back in 30m for status update.

deploy-bot: job 8812 canary step SUCCESS
deploy-bot: job 8812 rollout to remaining regions started
devon: canary smoke OK. no regressions.

sylvia: good. proceeding with global pin.

deploy-bot: job 8812 COMPLETED OK

ashley: thanks. keeping SEC-2026-1421 open until hotpatch deployed and verified.

rachel-legal: noted for release notes: "RC-9 rollout paused; rolled back to RC-8 due to vulnerability in optional analytics library. Hotpatch in progress." :white_check_mark:

sylvia: end-of-thread update: Pin completed, monitoring stable, hotpatch ETA 3h. Closing coordination in this thread — will link to SEC ticket and PM release note.
